summary: Verified the fix for the HIGH-priority scroll-reset bug in Brand Studio (removal of key={version} on the View wrapping Stack in app/_layout.tsx). Tested via Playwright on mobile viewport (375x667), logged in as coach jcgfit@gmail.com, navigated to /brand-studio, scrolled to the BRAND COLOR/TYPOGRAPHY section, and tapped both a color swatch and a font pack option.
critical_code_review_comments: app/_layout.tsx fix confirmed: key={version} prop removed from the View wrapping Stack; useTheme() call retained so ThemedApp still re-renders on theme change without forcing a full navigator remount. Clean, minimal fix.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Scroll-reset bug is CONFIRMED FIXED. Font pack tap: scrollTop 922->905 (no reset, checkmark moved to 'Bold Impact', Anton font visibly applied). Color swatch tap: scrollTop 905->905 (no reset, checkmark moved to Indigo swatch). Accent color change persisted and applied globally across Home tab icons, Programs tab icon, Settings tab icon on next navigation - confirms DB persistence + live theming works correctly. Navigation regression sanity (Home -> Programs -> Settings -> Home) all worked with no broken/un-themed screens, no red screen errors. This was the last remaining item from iteration_10/11; Brand Studio feature set can now be considered fully verified across all 3 rounds of testing.
rca_of_issue: N/A - this iteration confirms the fix, not a new bug. Original RCA (from iteration_11 handoff): key={version} on the root View caused React to unmount/remount the entire Stack navigator subtree on every theme/font state change, resetting all ScrollView scroll offsets to 0. Fix removes the key prop while keeping the component's re-render trigger via the useTheme() hook call, so styling still updates without a destructive unmount.
